Wenhui original colored front preserved. Existing twelve side-window backs use unchanged opaque mixed bluegray proxy; photo shows grilles/AC, not pure measured glass; opposite side is repeated-component inference. Extend gray entry sill/head/frame top, dark original mullion returns, and green canopy soffit/back/end returns across complete original component supports. Hidden finishes are continuity inference from official PDF page74, not a direct survey. Pink and olive side transitions lack matching topology, so all main side walls, side window jambs, rear, terraces, main roofs/coping and artificial base remain neutral. Extra official map/scenery, Commons and web research found no verified rear photograph; official VR endpoints unavailable. Photograph dates unknown; no 2026-condition claim.
